review_candidates.title: DevOps Engineer
review_candidates.description: Role Description This part-time remote DevOps Engineer role at Cubo Digital focuses on building and maintaining reliable, scalable infrastructure to support software delivery. The DevOps Engineer collaborates with development and operations teams to design, implement, and improve CI pipelines, monitor system performance, and troubleshoot issues in production and staging environments. Day-to-day work includes writing and maintaining infrastructure as code, managing Linux-based servers, automating deployment processes, and optimizing system configuration for security, resilience, and efficiency. The role also involves documenting workflows, participating in code reviews, and contributing to best practices for observability, incident response, and infrastructure cost management. Qualifications Strong skills in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools and practices to define, provision, and manage cloud or on-premises infrastructure. Experience in Software Development, including scripting or programming languages commonly used in DevOps (e.g., Python, Go, Bash). Hands-on background in Continuous Integration (CI), including setting up and maintaining CI pipelines and build automation. Solid System Administration skills, with emphasis on Linux server management, performance tuning, and troubleshooting. Knowledge of containerization and orchestration (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes) and modern deployment strategies (e.g., blue-green, canary) is beneficial. Familiarity with monitoring, logging, and alerting tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK stacks, cloud-native services). Understanding of cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP), networking fundamentals, and security best practices in DevOps environments. Ability to work independently in a remote setting, communicate clearly with cross-functional teams, and manage time effectively in a part-time role. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Experience with GDS support, training, or user assistance. Fluent English communication skills. Knowledge of travel industry standards and procedures. Strong attention to detail, organization, and accuracy.

Team Culture: Collaborative, innovative, and supportive. Remote Flexibility: Work hybridly. Creative Freedom: Blend UX strategy with visual design and branding. Time Off: Paid vacation and holidays, plus your birthday off. Competitive Compensation: Your experience is recognised and rewarded. Wellness Support: Internet, fitness allowances, and other benefits. Team Culture: Join a collaborative and innovative environment shaping the future of finance.
